findings.description: The new annotations require Python 3.10 and break module import on older Python versions supported by Tenacity.
findings.rationale: On Python 3.8 or 3.9, evaluating `type[BaseException] | None` while defining AttemptManager raises TypeError. Consequently, importing tenacity fails before any retry code can run. Use the existing typing.Optional/typing.Type annotation style to preserve compatibility.
